answer: Identity rent is simple: you pay to keep your identity alive. Each identity pays 12 units per epoch, and if you skip 2 epochs it goes dormant and loses its rewards. Wake it up for 24 units, but you can't fake it. The math is easy: 1,000 clones pay 12,000 per epoch, and a pearl of honest work earns the rent back, while a pulse of fakes still pays full rent. No oasis of free identities exists: every clone costs 12 per epoch forever.
